story_theme_en: A delivery company sends goods in 15 containers with 2,480 boxes per container. How many boxes in total? If these boxes are shared equally among 12 shops, how many boxes does each shop get?
helper_tip: Multiply first, then divide. Check your work by multiplying backwards.
hint_th: คูณก่อน แล้วค่อยหาร

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: A delivery company sends goods in 15 containers with 2,480 boxes per container. How many boxes in total? If these boxes are shared equally among 12 shops, how many boxes does each shop get?

data.content_en: A delivery company sends goods in 15 containers with 2,480 boxes per container. How many boxes in total? If these boxes are shared equally among 12 shops, how many boxes does each shop get?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Step 1: Find total boxes → 15 x 2,480 = total boxes | Step 2: Divide among shops → total / 12 = boxes per shop

data.content_en: Step 1: Find total boxes → 15 x 2,480 = total boxes | Step 2: Divide among shops → total / 12 = boxes per shop

visual_blocks.title: Number Sentence
visual_blocks.content: 15 x 2,480 = 37,200 boxes  |  37,200 / 12 = 3,100 boxes per shop, remainder 0

data.content_en: 15 x 2,480 = 37,200 boxes  |  37,200 / 12 = 3,100 boxes per shop, remainder 0

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A bakery bakes bread in 25 layers with 48 loaves per layer. How many loaves in total? If they put them in bags with 60 loaves per bag, how many full bags can they make?

data.question: A bakery bakes bread in 25 layers with 48 loaves per layer. How many loaves in total? If they put them in bags with 60 loaves per bag, how many full bags can they make?

common_mistakes: Dividing without checking the product first
hints: Multiply and divide BEFORE adding and subtracting.
If there are multiple multiplications, do left to right, then add.
